# Zakaria Teffah - Software Engineer

> Experienced software engineer with 14+ years building robust, high-performance software: architecture, algorithms, optimization, scientific computing and agentic AI. Based in Montpellier, France.

## Professional Summary

Software engineer with 14+ years building critical tools for industry leaders such as Airbus and Liebherr. I enjoy owning problems end-to-end: understanding the need, designing the architecture, and shipping tested, performant code. Rigorous and adaptable, I ramp up quickly on new domains and technologies, and I leverage AI coding agents to speed up delivery. My core strength is abstraction. I hold an MSc in Computer Science, Mathematics and Modelling from INSA Toulouse.

## Skills

- **Languages**: C/C++ (advanced), Python (advanced), Rust, Bash, MiniZinc, Lean4, TLA+, VHDL/Verilog
- **Expertise**: Software Architecture, Algorithms & Data Structures, Numerical Optimization, Mathematical Modelling, HPC, Testing & CI, Agentic AI (agents, MCP)
- **Soft Skills**: Abstraction (core strength), Rigor, Adaptability, Autonomy, Curiosity, Team Communication
- **Spoken Languages**: French (native), English (C1 fluent), Spanish (reading), Chinese (reading)

## Experience

### NanoXplore — C++/Python R&D Engineer (Montpellier)
C++ toolchain development for FPGA design software: graph/hypergraph algorithms, pattern matching, logic equivalence checking (BDD, SMT), performance optimization.
Technologies: C++, Python, Graph Algorithms, SMT Solvers, VHDL/Verilog, Testing

### Liebherr Aerospace — Scientific Tools Engineer (Toulouse)
Heat transfer algorithms for aircraft icing prediction, scientific computation library for roller bearing modeling, uncertainties propagation computation for sensor-dependent physical quantities.
Technologies: C++, Python, Scientific Computing, Numerical Optimization

### Airbus (via Altran) — Methods & Tools Consultant (Toulouse)
Airbus flight simulator stability optimization, aircraft trajectory simulation and optimization tools, multi-physics simulation for A30X wing optimization using kriging ML.
Technologies: C++, Optimization, Machine Learning, Design Patterns, Aerodynamics

## Education
